question: After the O9 smoke repairs changed shipped sources, does the current HEAD still control a public video-only live broadcast through the documentOutput/Capture path?

site.shape: on-screen video-only MediaStream, Infinity duration, playing, currentTime > 25, no audible finite advertisement

command: cd nexus/apps/extension-spectra && SPECTRA_DOCUMENT_OUTPUT_LIVE_URL=https://www.huya.com/102411 NEXUS_CHROME_EXECUTABLE="C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe" bun test test/smoke/document-output.spec.ts

runs.name: controls separate page audio and releases through audio-reset
controls separate page audio and releases through restore-page-settings
controls a public separated live output with the product graph oracle

assertionsProven: The popup volume slider on the public live room reports volumeBase.strategy === 'capture'.
The same snapshot reports live === true.
The offscreen product-graph analyser has a nonzero live output baseline (> 1e-5).
volume-0 and muted drive the product output RMS below 1e-6.
volume-70, unmuted and the shortcut each keep the product output RMS above 1e-5.
The shortcut ACK reaches volumeBase.actual === 80 and restore-page-settings succeeds.
The media registry still admits the on-screen video-only broadcast instead of a finite pre-roll.
findings: The two shipped-source repairs (live-rank preservation in media-registry and a stable pending restore plan in runtime-loader) did not regress the current HEAD's real-site documentOutput/Capture control path.

The rebuilt artifact is deterministic for this HEAD: manifest.json, content-bootstrap.js and offscreen.js keep the 2026-11-14 hashes, while background.js changes exactly because runtime-loader.ts changed.
The six O9 failures themselves were fixture-level assertions on the built extension; this run does not claim to reproduce them on a public live site.
